entities.name: PMID:25070676
observations: Raghavan et al. studied PPMS and relapsing-onset MS in the CLIMB longitudinal cohort.
The study compared disability progression using interval-censored survival analysis and six-month sustained progression.
The PubMed abstract reports a PPMS median time to sustained progression of 4.85 years (95% CI 2.83–8.35).

entities.name: CLIMB cohort
observations: The CLIMB population was a longitudinal MS cohort at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston.
The analyzed sample included 73 PPMS patients and 1,541 relapsing-onset MS patients.

entities.name: Primary progressive MS
observations: In the CLIMB analysis, PPMS progressed faster than relapsing-onset MS to EDSS 3 and from EDSS 3 to 6.
The reported median time to six-month sustained progression was 4.85 years (95% CI 2.83–8.35).

entities.name: PPMS sample-size estimates
observations: The paper title indicates that sample-size estimates were produced for PPMS trial design, but the accessible PubMed abstract does not report their numerical values or assumptions.
Publisher full text could not be retrieved in this review, so numerical sample-size estimates remain unverified here.
